identity.title: [v0.92.1][CORP-05] Transfer repository domain brand and vendor control

values.task_boundary: Implement only CORP-05 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Administrative-control manifest with source/destination identity, visibility, exact ref, owner, and live readback.
Redirect and legacy-repository disposition plan that preserves history without destructive founder-account mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Only the seven approved migration repositories move; asksifu and Horust remain unchanged.
Agent Design Language remains public and all other company repositories remain private unless separately authorized.
Founder-account repositories are copied or dispositioned without deletion or destructive history changes.
Domains, brands, Apps, webhooks, packages, Pages, OIDC, and repository references receive verified dispositions.
non_goals: Changing repository visibility beyond the approved matrix
